key_points.point: The authors introduce Dream-RSI, a framework that uses accumulated historical discovery trees as a replay simulator, enabling rapid off-policy evaluation of alternative exploration strategies. By treating past execution traces as a world model, the agent can 'dream' up thousands of alternative policies without incurring real-world computational costs. This operationalizes model-based reinforcement learning to bypass the delayed and expensive feedback inherent in online meta-search spaces. The method maintains a fixed underlying coding agent while dynamically rewriting the exploration policy code.
